title: Shadows under the strings: shadow maps, a baked ambient occlusion texture, contact shadows
question: What do the strings' and frets' shadows on the board cost as a dynamic shadow map (1024, 2048, 4096), a shadow map rendered once, an ambient occlusion texture baked on the CPU, and a contact shadow (a top-down depth pass, blurred)?
hypothesis: A dynamic shadow map doubles the draw calls of the shadow casters and costs GPU time growing with its size; rendering it once costs nothing per frame; the baked texture costs a one-time bake on the CPU; the contact shadow costs a pass and a blur per frame.

predictions.metric: drawCalls, dynamic shadow map against none
median GPU ms, 4096 against 1024 dynamic shadow map
predictions.predicted: at most 1.5x (the shadow pass draws few triangles)
